sentence: Tracks shared trip expenses paid by different people, splits them evenly in whole cents, and shows the fewest payments needed to settle up, with each person marking their own payments as sent.
use_when: A group wants to split costs from a trip or weekend away
Several people paid for different things and need to know who owes whom
Someone asks for a breakdown of expenses and the fewest payments to settle
People want to add an expense or mark a payment as sent
dont_use_when: A single bill needs splitting by item or by uneven percentages
A one-off money request or payment to one person with no shared expenses
A poll or vote on where to go or what to do
